scope: Conventional-control validation on an existing private synthetic development set. No qualification, consciousness, natural-world capability, or learning-superiority claim. Prior acquisition records remain unchanged.
accounting: All additional measured search, candidate construction, template canonicalization, validation traversals, interpreter, comparator, disclosed audit and final independent buyer work are charged. No free validation or hidden fallback. Comparator work is included in the same validation ceiling. CPU and source hashes are reported separately.

dataset.fold: int(sha256(private_recipe.program_sha256.encode()).hexdigest()[:8],16) mod 2; metadata used only to select matching frozen history, never passed to actor

actor_inputs: matching frozen training artifact accepted_programs and program_uses only
current first four diagnostic input/output rows

controls.retained_short_circuit: Same (-program_uses, program hash) order as original retained scan; reject at first disclosed-row mismatch; return first complete disclosed fit; remaining work invokes unchanged old_strong helper.
controls.field_templates: Canonicalize field indices by deterministic first occurrence in retained AST history, including conditional field and branches; retain non-field parameters; template order follows first occurrence in retained history order. Enumerate bindings lexicographically over actual common current disclosed field count with repeated bindings allowed. A repeated source field remains the same slot. Deduplicate complete ASTs after paid construction; return first disclosed fit; remaining work invokes unchanged old_strong helper.

meter: Unmodified existing _Meter and evaluate interpreter; candidate count and serialized AST-byte charge, explicit primitive charge per validation/construction/canonicalization node visit, and observed output serialization; interpreter per-node/output charges remain unchanged. Exact retained() semantic parity compares unbounded original charges separately.
pilot_selection: Per fold, sort frozen prior spiking search work then job_id. Choose rank floor((2*i+1)*n/16) for i=0..7. Selection is fixed before running these controls and spans prior complexity without using new outcomes.
buyer_rule: Once a program is selected from disclosed examples, call final independent buyer once. No retry or adjustment after buyer rejection.
proof_plan: Formal deterministic first-fit equivalence for unbounded original full-row retained scan and short-circuit scan, plus paired finite 16-job execution using the same ordering and original charges; compare exact selected-program hashes, retained-hit versus absent and metered work. No full 384-job old-scan rerun is required.
full_run: Not included in pilot execution. Estimate cost after pilot.
write_policy: Append separate attempt evidence and retain all failed attempts. All new artifacts are confined to this validation directory.
